# truenas_app_stop (Action)

Stops an app (app.stop).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Stop an app (Terraform 1.14+).
action "truenas_app_stop" "example" {
  config {
    app_name = "nextcloud"
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_name` (String) App name (truenas_app.<name>.name).
